name: cloudy-sapgui
description: Classic SAP GUI transactions rebuilt as abap2UI5 apps.

scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_downport: abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc --fix && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run lint_standard
